required_content: human trafficking training and awareness campaigns

recordkeeping_requirements.description: retain guest transactions and receipts for at least six months

law_references: Introduction to Child Trafficking in Connecticut
Introduction to Human Trafficking in Connecticut for Law Enforcement

harbor_alliance_actions.description: Ensure annual training for relevant personnel, including DCF staff, foster parents, service providers, schools, law enforcement, hospitals, and medical staff.
Require hotels, motels, and lodging businesses to provide trafficking training and awareness campaigns annually.

risks_or_constraints: Lodging businesses must adhere to annual training requirements.
Training frequency is specified as annually, which may affect compliance.
